create_NewModelConfig: create a NewModelConfig class inheriting from GemmaConfig with custom model hyperparameters
build_NewModelConfig_defaults: build a NewModelConfig instance with overridden defaults like vocab_size 256030 and hidden_size 64
review_NewModelConfig: review the NewModelConfig class and its GemmaConfig parent with model configuration attributes
test_NewModelConfig_num_heads: test the NewModelConfig num_heads property returns the num_attention_heads value
summarize_NewModelConfig: summarize the NewModelConfig configuration including layer count attention dims and activation settings
